article.title: Ashley Farmer's 'Queen Mother' honors Queen Mother Audley Moore, finally
article.author: Tea Troutman
article.content: Given Moore’s position as both a cultural and political figure of high regard, who is widely known amongst students of the Black Radical Tradition and in Black Nationalist and reparations-centered organizing spaces, she has been minimally studied with the degree of rigor she deserves. Read more via Scalawag : Ashley Farmer's 'Queen Mother' honors Queen Mother Audley Moore, finally .
